sentences.text: 24 is a 2016 Indian Tamil-language science fiction thriller film written and directed by Vikram Kumar .	Vikram Kumar	Vikram Kumar	Tamil	Tamil language	science fiction	science fiction	thriller	Thriller (genre)	Vikram	Vikram (actor)

Based on the concept of time-travel , the film stars actor Suriya in triple roles , with actresses Samantha Ruth Prabhu , Nithya Menen and Saranya Ponvannan in lead roles .	Suriya	Suriya	Samantha Ruth Prabhu	Samantha Ruth Prabhu	Nithya Menen	Nithya Menen	Saranya Ponvannan	Saranya Ponvannan	time-travel	Time travel in fiction
The development dates back to 2009 , where the film was to feature actors Vikram and Ileana D'Cruz in lead roles .	Vikram	Vikram (actor)	Ileana D'Cruz	Ileana D'Cruz
However , in February 2010 , the project was dropped due to difference in opinions between director , producer and actor , facing rejection of the refined script .

In August 2014 , Suriya agreed to produce and act in the film , with principal photography commencing in Mumbai in April 2015 , continuing in Nasik , Goregaon and Pune .	Suriya	Suriya	principal photography	principal photography	Mumbai	Mumbai	Nasik	Nasik	Goregaon	Goregaon	Pune	Pune
The second phase of filming was done in Poland by end-September 2015 .	Poland	Poland
Filming was completed in Chennai by November 2015 .	Chennai	Chennai
Produced by 2D Entertainment , the film has cinematography by S. Tirru .	Tirru	Tirru	2D Entertainment	2D Entertainment	cinematography	cinematography	S. Tirru	Tirru
The soundtrack and film score are composed by A. R. Rahman , with lyrics by Vairamuthu and Madhan Karky .	A. R. Rahman	A. R. Rahman	Vairamuthu	Vairamuthu	Madhan Karky	Madhan Karky
The film along with the dubbed Telugu version having the same title was released on 6 May 2016 .	Telugu	Telugu language
It is also dubbed in Hindi as Time Story .

The film won two awards at the 64th National Film Awards Best Cinematography and Best Production Design .	64th National Film Awards	64th National Film Awards	Best Cinematography	National Film Award for Best Cinematography	Best Production Design	National Film Award for Best Production Design
